settings.visualStyle: AI-generated historical reenactment styled as black-and-white 35mm Omaha Beach D-Day 1944 wartime field-newsreel footage. Cold surf, smoke, beach obstacles, shingle, wet sand, U.S. Army uniforms, M1 helmets, rifles and landing craft. Moderate grain, gate weave, dust, scratches, flicker, soft optics and imperfect exposure. Non-graphic combat only. No modern objects, HDR, drone, gimbal, glossy lighting, game-like framing or copied movie shots.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. A human combat cameraman is physically inside the landing force. He is packed into the landing craft, wades in water, uses obstacles and shingle for cover, runs only when soldiers run, ducks under fire, gets spray and sand on the lens, and cannot film from ahead of the assault or from impossible safe angles. No dialogue, narration, subtitles or music. Diegetic sound only.
settings.customVisualStyle: Human-operated D-Day field-camera realism: cramped craft framing, boat roll, waterline splashes, lens spray, short exposed runs, abrupt drops into cover, bodies blocking the view, heavy gear bounce, smoke-softened focus and shaky recovery after nearby impacts.

cameraPresenceLock.cameraOperator: anonymous combat cameraman physically landing with U.S. infantry

archivalLookLock.presentation: AI-generated reenactment with archival-style treatment; never claim genuine archive footage.
archivalLookLock.audioPolicy: No music, narration or intelligible dialogue. Diegetic sound only.

movie.plotDetails: A fictional U.S. infantryman anchors continuity while the human cameraman lands in the same craft and shares the same exposure.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a two-minute Omaha Beach assault reenactment as if a human combat cameraman landed in the same craft with U.S. infantry. Camera must obey boat motion, surf depth, obstacles, cover, incoming fire and human reaction time. Follow landing craft, ramp, wading, obstacles, shingle, brief return fire, short rushes, bluff base, quiet breath and inland climb. Black-and-white 35mm newsreel treatment. No dialogue, narration or music. Non-graphic and period accurate.
movie.storySummary: A U.S. infantryman braces in a landing craft, wades ashore, moves through obstacles, reaches shingle cover, returns brief fire and advances by short rushes before climbing inland. The cameraman shares every movement and never gains a clean omniscient view of the beach.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP08 — Normandy 1944: Omaha Beach Assault

scenes.title: Inside the Landing Craft
scenes.description: Packed infantry braces as craft pitches toward shore.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier grips wet steel as men lean with craft motion.
scenes.imageDescription: June 1944 landing craft interior, U.S. infantry, M1 helmets, wet steel, grey light, black-and-white 35mm grain.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman is wedged shoulder-to-shoulder among troops. Boat roll tilts frame naturally; helmets and packs repeatedly block the lens. He braces against steel and cannot step backward for a wide shot. Audio: engine, hull vibration, waves, gear, breathing.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains inside craft directly behind lead soldier.

scenes.title: Ramp Drops
scenes.description: Ramp falls and smoky beach fills view.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman moves with first group into water.
scenes.imageDescription: Open ramp, grey surf, smoke-covered beach, U.S. infantry moving out.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator reacts to ramp crash with a jolt; bright exterior briefly overexposes, then he follows behind the first men rather than filming from front. Bodies obscure most of beach until they clear the ramp. Audio: ramp crash, surf, distant gunfire, engine.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera steps into shallow water behind lead soldier.

scenes.title: Into the Surf
scenes.description: Heavy gear makes every step unstable.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman wades forward through spray.
scenes.imageDescription: Water-level D-Day approach, U.S. infantry in surf, obstacles ahead, smoke.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman wades too at chest/shoulder height, camera jolting with each submerged step. Spray hits lens and leaves droplets; one passing soldier blocks view completely for a beat. Audio: splashing, surf, gear, gunfire, breath.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Lens remains wet as group nears obstacles.

scenes.title: Steel Obstacles
scenes.description: The soldier passes between beach obstacles.
scenes.actionDescription: He angles around one steel obstacle toward dry sand.
scenes.imageDescription: Omaha obstacle zone, wet steel, surf, smoke, infantry inland.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator uses same obstacle as partial cover, moving around it after the soldier. Steel fills one side of frame, water droplets distort highlights, camera never floats clear of obstacle line. Audio: surf, metal clang, boots, rounds farther away.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera leaves obstacle behind with lead soldier ahead.

scenes.title: Run to the Shingle
scenes.description: The soldier makes a short exposed dash.
scenes.actionDescription: He runs low and drops behind gravel bank.
scenes.imageDescription: Open wet beach, smoke, obstacles, shingle bank, running infantry.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman runs behind him a fraction late; heavy gear and wet sand cause violent human bounce and momentary ground framing. He dives behind shingle at same time, camera striking low. Audio: boots, gunfire, gear, breath.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator low behind shingle beside troops.

scenes.title: Pinned Low
scenes.description: The first cover is shallow and compressed.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier lies low catching breath.
scenes.imageDescription: Gravel cover, wet uniforms, smoke, tired infantry, no firing in this beat.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman lies prone too; gravel and a nearby pack block lower and side frame. Camera trembles with breathing, lens droplets and sand remain. Audio: breath, gravel, surf, distant gunfire.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains prone as soldier prepares to return fire.

scenes.title: Brief Supporting Fire
scenes.description: The line returns controlled fire toward bluffs.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman raises briefly and fires.
scenes.imageDescription: Shingle line, rifleman partly exposed, distant bluff, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator stays lower than soldier and only lifts lens enough over gravel to catch short firing beat; frame partially blocked by helmet and bank. He ducks immediately after soldier. Audio: rifle shots, gravel impacts, surf.

scenes.title: Obstacle to Crater
scenes.description: The squad moves to shallow crater or obstacle base.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman makes one short rush and drops.
scenes.imageDescription: Smoke-heavy beach, obstacle remains, shallow cover, small groups moving.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman waits one second after first men move, then runs behind; frame loses lead soldier behind smoke, catches him again only when both drop into cover. Audio: boots, gear, sand debris, distant shots.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator crouches in new shallow cover.

scenes.title: Look Toward the Bluff
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier studies rising ground from low cover.
scenes.imageDescription: View from beach cover toward bluff approaches, smoke, scattered troops.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator remains low; cover occupies bottom third. He follows soldier’s gaze upward with a slow hand tilt, wind and breathing causing minor drift. No high clean beach overview. Audio: surf, wind, distant gunfire.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera returns to soldier as gap through obstacles is noticed.

scenes.title: Move Through Wire Gap
scenes.description: The section finds a narrow route through obstacles.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier ducks through gap behind another man.
scenes.imageDescription: Damaged beach wire, obstacle gap, U.S. infantry passing carefully.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman follows last through narrow gap; wire and backs nearly fill frame, lens brushes close to wet metal and camera tilts to fit through. Audio: metal vibration, boots, wind, distant firing.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator clears gap behind lead soldier.

scenes.title: Base of the Rise
scenes.description: The men reach better cover at rising ground.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier drops beside sandy embankment.
scenes.imageDescription: Base of bluff, sandy earth, grass, exhausted wet infantry, beach smoke behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator arrives winded and sinks to knees behind same bank; camera briefly points at sand before lifting. Surf now farther away. Audio: breathing, distant battle, muted surf.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera rests behind embankment with soldier.

scenes.title: One Breath
scenes.description: A brief quiet beat before climb.
scenes.actionDescription: He wipes seawater and sand from face.
scenes.imageDescription: Exhausted soldier, sandy embankment, wet helmet strap, rifle low.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman rests too, almost motionless at chest height with breathing sway; no staged close-up or dolly. Water spot remains near edge. Audio: breath, distant artillery, surf.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator rises as section starts climbing.

scenes.title: Climb Inland
scenes.description: The section climbs away from exposed beach.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman climbs rough slope behind comrades.
scenes.imageDescription: Sandy grassy slope, smoke below, U.S. troops climbing.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator climbs behind using one hand for balance; camera repeatedly dips to ground and tilts with body weight, never floating beside climbers. Audio: boots in sand, breathing, distant gunfire.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera reaches higher ground behind squad.

scenes.title: Beach Below
scenes.description: The shoreline is visible from higher ground.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier pauses once and looks back.
scenes.imageDescription: Elevated view back over Omaha shoreline, craft, smoke, obstacles, soldier foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman reaches the same human-height pause and turns late with soldier; grasses and another helmet cut into frame, and horizon remains slightly tilted from climb. No sweeping crane view. Audio: wind, distant surf, battlefield rumble.

scenes.title: Inland
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman follows unit away from shoreline.
scenes.imageDescription: U.S. infantry moving toward hedged inland route, smoke behind, no victory celebration.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator follows a few tired steps then stops; holds human shoulder-height view as troops disappear around hedge, with subtle breathing sway and remaining lens spray. No aerial pull-back. Audio: boots, wind, distant battle only.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Final frame holds on empty inland path and distant smoke.

characters.name: Landing Infantryman
characters.description: Anonymous U.S. Army infantryman in historically plausible 1944 D-Day field gear, M1 helmet, rifle, web equipment and pack.

continuity.continuityRules: Same face, M1 helmet, rifle and web gear. Clothing becomes soaked early and remains wet and sandy.

props.personalProps: rifle, M1 helmet, web gear, assault pack
